
  Lower an API spec (OpenAPI 3.x) into Morphic IR JSON on stdout, and write diagnostics to stderr.
  Output to stdout is indented for reading; a file written with --output is compact unless --pretty
  asks for the indented form.

  --explain reports what compiling produced at one source coordinate — the type node interned there,
  the coordinates interned beneath it, and the diagnostics stamped at it — instead of writing the
  document. The coordinate is a JSON Pointer, so '' is the whole document. It writes no file, so it
  cannot be combined with --output.

  --opt passes a setting to the compiler the spec selects, which names and validates its own
  options; morphic itself knows none of them. The OpenAPI compiler's are listed in the README.

  A -- argument ends flag parsing: every argument after it is an operand, even one that begins with
  a dash, which is how a spec file named like a flag is passed.

  Exit status is 0 when nothing reaches --fail-on, 1 when something does or the spec lowered to no
  document at all, and 2 for a misuse or an I/O error.

  USAGE

    morphic compile <spec-file> [--flags]

  EXAMPLES

    # IR JSON to stdout
    morphic compile openapi.yaml

    # ...or to a file
    morphic compile openapi.yaml -o api.ir.json

    # what compiling produced at one source coordinate
    morphic compile openapi.yaml --explain /components/schemas/Pet

    # pass settings to the compiler the spec selects
    morphic compile openapi.yaml --opt grouping=path-prefix --opt overlay=patch.yaml

  FLAGS

    --explain        Report what compiling produced at this pointer instead of the IR; '' is the whole document
    --fail-on        Exit 1 on diagnostics at or above this severity: error or warning (error)
    -h --help        Help for compile
    --opt            Set one key=value option on the compiler the spec selects (repeatable)
    -o --output      Write IR JSON to this file instead of stdout
    --pretty         Indent the IR JSON --output writes; stdout is indented either way
    --skip-validate  Skip the referential-integrity validate pass
